# Archived regression inputs

These files are byte-for-byte copies of earlier recorded guest traces. They preserve four- and five-scenario compatibility, one-restart and zero-restart cases, and a deliberately unsuitable comparison pair with different fault/watchdog settings. The two November 22 comparison inputs include their raw consoles and source snapshots so the demo builder can verify them before rejecting the confounded comparison.

Tests create explicitly synthetic mutations in memory or temporary directories. Such mutations do not represent additional QNX executions. Current demo recordings remain in `prototype/artifacts` and are selected by `build_demo.py`.
